# The DRIPBaR Edina

> The DRIPBaR Edina is an IV therapy and wellness lounge in Edina, Minnesota. Services include IV vitamin drips, intramuscular quick shots, NAD+ infusions, High Dose Vitamin C, physician-guided GLP-1 medical weight management, medically supervised peptide therapy, and wellness therapies, delivered by a licensed clinical team under physician oversight. 

Key facts:
- Address: 3515 W. 70th St, Edina, MN 55435
- Phone (call or text): (612) 324-4740
- Hours: Monday to Friday: 10 AM to 6 PM; Saturday: 10 AM to 4 PM; Sunday: 11 AM to 3 PM
- Booking: https://thedripbaredina.com/booking (online, 24/7) or by phone
- Pricing: Lifestyle IV drips are $224 regular and $179 for members. Priced separately: 100% Hydration $109, The Debut $165 (same price for members), NAD+ $199 or $159 for members, Alpha Lipoic Acid $199 or $159 for members, High Dose Vitamin C from $189 (set at consultation). Quick shots are $25 to $50; NAD+ shots start at $65.
- Lifestyle Membership: $179 per month includes one Lifestyle drip, a free monthly member perk, 20% off additional drips, and unused drips roll over. Elevate Membership is $339 per month.
- Google rating: 5.0 across 245+ reviews.
- No health screening is required before a standard IV drip or quick shot in Minnesota; guests complete a short intake form and the wellness team helps them choose. NAD+ requires a $40 consultation before the first infusion.
- Peptide therapy is $249 per month, set at a consultation; peptides ship from the pharmacy to the guest and are self-administered as a subcutaneous injection with clinical guidance and physician oversight.
- New guest offer: $20 off your first appointment for new guests.
- All IV drips and quick shots are administered by registered nurses under physician oversight. Nothing on this site is medical advice; a consultation is required for GLP-1, peptide, High Dose Vitamin C, Ozone Therapy, and NAD+ planning.
- High Dose Vitamin C, how it works: at everyday doses Vitamin C is an antioxidant. At the high concentrations only an IV reaches it becomes a pro-oxidant and produces hydrogen peroxide in the tissues, so it is not an antioxidant at these doses. Offered in 15,000 to 75,000 mg doses from $189 as complementary support alongside oncology care, never in place of it, and for chronic inflammatory conditions, infections, and wound healing. Requires a physician consultation, labs, and a prescription. Not a treatment or cure for cancer or any disease.
